_meta.description: The 17 Line 5 station points in MMRDA's alignment file (uploaded March 2025), in order from Kapurbawdi. Positions come from that file (scripts/build-alignment-line5.py). 'phase' follows the revised split (post on X, 31 Aug 2026): 1 Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, 2 Dhamankar Naka to Durgadi, 3 Durgadi to Kalyan. 'revised_plan_2026' says what the revised plan (State approval 22 Apr 2026, Union approval 29 Aug 2026) does with each station, from news reports of that approval; MMRDA has not published the revised station list. 'eia_chainage_m' is the station's chainage in MMRDA's Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023). The report's chainages do not match the distances between the station points in the alignment file (for example Kalher to Purna: 0.83 km in the report, about 2 km apart on the map); they are kept as published. 'same_site_as' names a station of another line at the same place, with the distance between the two points.

stations.name: Kapurbawdi

location.method: MMRDA alignment file for Line 5 (KML on the Metro Influence Zone page, uploaded March 2025): point "Kapurbawdi(M)station". along_m is measured along a centre line derived from MMRDA's corridor polygon, from its start at Kapurbawdi; the point is 1 m from that line.

construction_status.value: Built as part of Metro Line 4, not under Line 5's contracts
construction_status.notes: MMRDA's Phase 1 environmental report (Sep 2023), Table 2.3: Kapurbawdi station is built as part of Metro Line 4 and is not one of Line 5's six Phase 1 stations.
